official: 羽村市行政手続条例の一部を改正する条例
name: 公示送達による通知方法を変更
summary: 行政手続法の改正に合わせて、条例を改正します。不利益処分の前に必要な聴聞や弁明の機会の通知を公示送達で行う場合、インターネットで閲覧できるようにし、市の事務所でも書面や電子画面で確認できるようにします。
changes: 公示送達による通知を、インターネットと市の事務所で閲覧できるようにする
who: 不利益処分の対象となり、公示送達で通知を受ける人
why: 行政手続法の改正に合わせるためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Changes how notices by public notice are made available
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Hamura City Administrative Procedure Ordinance
en.summary: The city will amend the ordinance to align it with amendments to the Administrative Procedure Act. When notices of a hearing or an opportunity to explain, which are required before an adverse disposition, are given by service by public notice, they will be available to view online and to check in writing or on electronic screens at the city offices.
changes: Makes notices served by public notice available to view online and at the city offices
who: People subject to an adverse disposition who receive notice by service by public notice
en.why: The city says this is to align the ordinance with amendments to the Administrative Procedure Act.
